title: Immunostimulatory effects of isomalto/malto-polysaccharides via TLR2 and TLR4 in preventing doxycycline-induced cytokine loss.
authors: Silva-Lagos, Luis; Ijaz, Adil; Buwalda, P; Kassai, Sonia; Klostermann, Cynthia E; Leemhuis, Hans; Veldhuizen, Edwin J A; Schols, Henk A; Lopez-Velazquez, Gabriel; de Vos, Paul
one_liner_zh: 该文研究多糖通过TLR2/TLR4激活NF-kB信号通路及免疫调节作用，分子对接仅涉及蛋白-糖配体，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Isomalto/malto-polysaccharides (IMMPs) are alpha-glucans with prebiotic potential used as food ingredients. However, their ability to exert direct cellular effects remains unknown. IMMPs may enhance immunity by activating toll-like receptors (TLRs), key for defense against pathogens. Doxycycline is an antibiotic that requires an effective immune function but paradoxically has immune-attenuating effects by reducing TLR2 activity, potentially increasing antibiotic needs. We hypothesize that IMMPs are recognized by various cell surface TLRs, leading to the activation of the NF-kappaB signaling pathway. Furthermore, IMMPs' immune-stimulating effect could prevent the doxycycline-induced reduction of TLR2 activity in immune cells. IMMPs activated TLR2, increasing NF-kappaB signaling by 3.42- and 6.37-fold at 1 and 2 mg/mL, respectively. TLR4 activation increased 5.47-, 7.39-, and 8.34-fold at 0.5, 1, and 2 mg/mL. IMMPs enhanced IL-8, TNFalpha, and IL1-RA production in THP-1 monocytes. Additionally, preincubation of macrophages with IMMPs enhanced cytokine production and partially prevented doxycycline-induced cytokine reduction in response to TLR2 activation. Molecular docking analyses support IMMPs and doxycycline binding to these TLRs. These findings suggest that IMMPs stimulate immunity via TLR2 and TLR4, partially mitigating doxycycline's adverse effects. This provides a dietary strategy to enhance pathogen clearance, reduce antibiotic needs, and support immune health.
abstract_zh: 异麦芽/麦芽多糖（IMMPs）是具有益生元潜力的α-葡聚糖，用作食品成分。然而，它们发挥直接细胞效应的能力仍属未知。IMMPs可能通过激活Toll样受体（TLRs）增强免疫，TLRs是对抗病原体的关键。多西环素是一种需要有效免疫功能但矛盾地具有免疫减弱效应的抗生素，其通过降低TLR2活性，可能增加抗生素需求。我们假设IMMPs被多种细胞表面TLRs识别，导致NF-kappaB信号通路激活。此外，IMMPs的免疫刺激效应可能阻止多西环素诱导的免疫细胞中TLR2活性降低。IMMPs激活TLR2，在1和2 mg/mL浓度下分别使NF-kappaB信号增加3.42倍和6.37倍。TLR4激活在0.5、1和2 mg/mL浓度下分别增加5.47倍、7.39倍和8.34倍。IMMPs增强了THP-1单核细胞中IL-8、TNFalpha和IL1-RA的产生。此外，巨噬细胞与IMMPs预孵育增强了细胞因子产生，并部分阻止了多西环素诱导的TLR2激活响应中细胞因子减少。分子对接分析支持IMMPs和多西环素与这些TLRs结合。这些发现表明，IMMPs通过TLR2和TLR4刺激免疫，部分缓解多西环素的不良效应。这提供了一种饮食策略，以增强病原体清除、减少抗生素需求并支持免疫健康。
